  • Method Details

    • fileComplaint

      public Complaint fileComplaint(User sender, String studentId, UrgencyLevel urgency, String content)
      Files a complaint about a student on behalf of a teacher. Only teachers may call this; other callers receive an error and null is returned.
      Parameters:
      sender - the teacher filing the complaint
      studentId - the student being reported
      urgency - how urgent the issue is
      content - description of the complaint
      Returns:
      the created complaint, or null if the sender is not a teacher
